decision.recommendation: Use the language-to-parts-to-3D figure in the main paper; keep the standalone truck role-preservation graphic as a supporting artifact.
rationale: The selected main figure explains the offline-to-runtime mechanism and already includes short/long truck contrast.
The standalone truck figure is clearer as a diagnostic, but it repeats the same visual claim and should not consume main-paper space.
The quantitative evidence is the part-invariance check, not the standalone graphic itself.
decision.claim_boundary: This supports role-specific parametric adaptation under synthetic dimensions. It is not proof that SPPA recovers truck morphology from UAV imagery and not an image-to-3D SOTA comparison.
